pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" substances" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 2. After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six, no person this state anti-fogging sprays or wipes polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals or that contain perfluoroalkyl and alkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish in regulation.

exceptions.provenance: 3.  No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section.
